Package Domain.Controllers

Interface IAdminCtrl

All Known Implementing Classes:
AdminCtrlLocalPersistence, AdminCtrlNoDB
public interface IAdminCtrl
Interface defining operations for managing Admin instances. Implementations of this interface handle the persistence and retrieval of Admin objects.
